title: 江戸鼠と、路地裏の記憶
author: 藤堂 小太郎

en.title: The Edo Rat and the Memories of the Back Alleys
en.premise: Genji, a young man making his living as a handyman in the tenement houses of Edo, discovers a "secret map" hidden at the bottom of an old chest while repairing it for a deceased resident. The strange diagram suggests that a certain "forgotten thing" lies sleeping within the labyrinthine back alleys of the city. On a night when the fervor of a festival envelops the streets, the map leads Genji to a story of human bonds more precious than any gold or silver.

zh.title: 江户之鼠与后巷的回忆
zh.premise: 身为长屋杂役、每日奔波忙碌的青年源次，在修理一位已故隐居者的旧箪笥时，意外发现了隐藏在底部的“秘密地图”。那是一张奇特的图纸，预示着在江户迷宫般的后巷深处，正沉睡着某件“被遗忘之物”。在祭典的热潮笼罩全城的夜晚，顺着地图的指引，源次将邂逅一段比金银财宝更加珍贵的、关于人与人之间羁绊的故事。
